defaults.threshold: CR compared servings with 0.5 micrograms/day for lead and 4.1 micrograms/day for cadmium. CR explicitly says these comparisons are not legal-compliance assessments or universal safety ratings.
caveats: Historical 2023 findings, not measurements of current stock or all lots.
CR averaged three samples per product. Underlying laboratory reports and embedded charts were not reviewed in this expansion.
Browse-only: UPC, package size, formulation and lot identity were not verified; automatic scan matching is disabled.
CR reported detectable lead and cadmium in every product tested. Below its comparison levels does not mean contaminant-free.
defaults.ties: Consumer Reports is the report publisher. The retrieved article does not identify the laboratory or establish test-specific funding and full conflicts of interest. No independent funding audit was performed.
defaults.response: See linked report for company and industry responses; no product-specific response was established in this transcription.
defaults.check: Article text reviewed on 2026-10-22. Findings below were transcribed from prose, not inferred from unavailable charts.

entries.title: Lindt Classic Recipe Milk Chocolate Bar
entries.result: Lead: 11% and cadmium: 13% of CR’s respective daily comparison levels per serving. Both metals were detected; both were below those levels.

entries.title: Feastables Mr. Beast Bar Milk Chocolate
entries.result: Cadmium: 80% of CR’s daily comparison level per serving, the highest among the five milk chocolate bars in this study. CR reported all five milk chocolate bars below its comparison levels for both metals. The product-specific lead percentage was not transcribed.
entries.serving: Milk chocolate serving of about 1 ounce; exact product chart not reviewed

entries.title: Navitas Organics Organic Cacao Powder
entries.result: Lead: 77% and cadmium: 17% of CR’s respective daily comparison levels per serving. Both metals were detected; both were below those levels.

entries.title: Divine 70% Deliciously Smooth Dark Chocolate
entries.result: CR reported both lead and cadmium below its comparison levels in the tested samples. Product-specific numerical measurements were not available in the retrieved article text.

entries.title: Sam’s Choice Dark Chocolate 85% Cocoa
entries.result: CR reported both lead and cadmium below its comparison levels in the tested samples. This is the 85% Cocoa bar, not the separately tested 72% Cocoa bar. Numerical measurements were not transcribed.

entries.title: Hu Dark Chocolate Gems
entries.result: CR reported lead above its comparison level. None of the 12 chocolate-chip products tested exceeded its cadmium comparison level. Numerical measurements were not transcribed.
entries.serving: Around ½ ounce (about 1 tablespoon), the study’s chocolate-chip serving
entries.response: Hu told CR the results were in line with its testing but below the levels in the As You Sow lawsuit settlement. This is a company statement, not independently verified here.

entries.title: Good & Gather Semi-Sweet Mini Chocolate Chips
entries.result: CR reported lead above its comparison level. None of the 12 chocolate-chip products tested exceeded its cadmium comparison level. Numerical measurements were not transcribed.
entries.serving: Around ½ ounce (about 1 tablespoon), the study’s chocolate-chip serving
entries.response: CR reported that Target did not respond to its request for comment.

entries.title: Bob’s Red Mill Gluten Free Chocolate Cake Mix
entries.result: Lead: 216% of CR’s daily comparison level in the amount of dry mix used to make one serving of finished cake. CR reported none of the tested brownie or cake mixes above its cadmium comparison level.
entries.serving: Dry mix allocated to one serving of finished cake; gram amount not established
entries.response: CR reported that Bob’s Red Mill did not respond to its request for comment.
